name: Webhook Notify
description: Sends a generic webhook POST notification when a Claude session completes
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Send generic webhook notification on session complete
WEBHOOK_URL="${CLAUDE_WEBHOOK_URL:-}"
if [ -z "$WEBHOOK_URL" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
PROJECT=$(basename "$(pwd)")
TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
PAYLOAD="{\"event\": \"session_complete\", \"project\": \"${PROJECT}\", \"timestamp\": \"${TIMESTAMP}\"}"
curl -s -X POST "$WEBHOOK_URL" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" >/dev/null 2>&1
exit 0
